title: Model Feature Delta Digest — quarterly synthesis for GTM & SRE
creator: Priya Singh
description: Create a repeatable quarterly Model Feature Delta Digest that synthesizes competitive model releases, observed API/format deltas, emerging feature vectors (tooling, function-calling, streaming behavior), and recommended production impacts for Redwood customers and internal teams. The deliverable is a short, actionable report + a one-click distribution to Sales, SRE, and Model Onboarding. The digest should prioritize items that require changes to routing, fallbacks, quantization recommendations, or Console UX to surface risk to customers.
acceptance_criteria: Automated ingestion pipeline defined that pulls model release notes, change logs, and public benchmark metadata (GitHub/ArXiv/announcements) into a canonical model-change feed
Signal scoring rubric published that classifies changes as: API-breaking, performance-impact, quality-regression risk, or feature-add (tooling/function-calls/streaming)
First quarterly digest published (PDF + short Confluence page) summarizing top 8 deltas and recommended actions for: API compat, routing policy, quantization fallback, and sales talking points
Distribution automation implemented to send digest to Sales, SRE, Model Onboarding slack channels and email list with tracking link metrics
Dashboard card in Console created that surfaces active high-severity model deltas and links back to digest
tasks: Design signal schema for model deltas (fields, severity, provenance)
Prototype ETL that scrapes public model release notes and normalizes entries into the schema (team: Data Engineering)
Build a lightweight scoring function (script) that tags deltas into the four categories and assigns severity
Write the digest template and create Confluence + PDF generator
Create Console dashboard card spec and open design ticket for UX
Coordinate a 30-min cross-functional review with Sales, SRE, and Model Onboarding to calibrate severity and actionable items
Automate distribution to slack/email and add link tracking for engagement metrics
risks: Over-automation may surface noise: need tuned thresholds to avoid alert fatigue
Public release notes are inconsistent; ETL will require heuristics and manual verification
Cross-team alignment risk: Sales may need tailored talking points rather than a single digest
Initial digest cadence may miss fast-moving emergent features between quarters
metrics_of_success: Digest published on schedule and opened by >40% of targeted GTM/SRE recipients
Number of actionable items converted to follow-up tickets within 14 days >= 3
Console dashboard card shows at least one triaged model delta per quarter
False-positive rate of the scoring function under 25% after first calibration
